interface.signature: def isEulerCircuit(V: int, adj: List[List[int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: V is a positive integer representing the number of vertices.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(adj, list) and all(isinstance(neighbors, list) for neighbors in adj) and len(adj) == V
preconditions.description: adj is a list of lists representing the adjacency list of the graph with V vertices.

postconditions.description: The function returns 0 if there is no Eulerian Path or Circuit, 1 if there is an Eulerian Path, and 2 if there is an Eulerian Circuit.
